judgement.overall_note: Production correctly carries over all four at-risk items and adds a new agreement covering the news-feed sensor and filtering priorities. However, it merges the two gold-prescribed additions (user builds sensor; default filtering priorities) into a single bullet, losing the explicit user-commitment aspect and the 'stripping out general commentary and repetition' component of the filter spec. The decision log is not updated to reflect the news-feed sensor adoption, which the gold requires. Overall quality is good but incomplete on the add side and missing the new decision entry.
